title: Leek and potato hash with eggs

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Potatoes, leeks, eggs, cheddar, butter, oil and herbs are all plain home staples.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a lidded frying pan and a grater, and the techniques are simple.

works.reason: 800g potatoes, 3 leeks and 4 eggs make a sensible hash for four, and the covered-then-uncovered frying and covered eggs will cook through.

honest_times.reason: For a breakfast asked to be quick, 15 minutes prep plus 25 cooking makes 40 minutes, and the steps actually add up to 27–28 minutes of cooking (15 + 8 + 4–5), so it is neither quick nor matched to the printed cook time.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used and nothing unlisted appears, though the step says 'paprika' where 'smoked paprika' is listed.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm leek and potato hash suits a cold January morning, and the leeks are central to the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are plain, clear British English a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Potatoes, leeks, eggs and cheese make a filling, real-food breakfast a family would happily eat.
